module: A rally pacenote (one co-driver note): class instantiated by the notebook (notebook, path.lua). It carries two waypoints (cornerStart and cornerEnd) in a sortedList, structured content with six slots (structured.lua), per-language texts (distance before/after, free text), an audio mode (auto, freeform, structuredOnline, structuredOffline, custom), a trigger type, geometric measurements of the corner and caches (compilation, length, camera position). It composes the text and audio files via the notebook's compositors and voicepack, produces the "compiled" object played by the co-driver (audioObjs, visual event), validates itself, serializes itself and draws itself in the editor (debugDrawer). Useful to a modder for reading or modifying a loaded notebook.
usage:
local Pacenote = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/notebook/pacenote')
local pn = Pacenote(notebook, 'Pacenote 12')
print(pn:noteOutputPreview(), pn:getAudioModeString())
local corner = pn:corner() -- nil or { type='corner', ... }
notes: The module returns a constructor: Pacenote(notebook, name, forceId). The notebook must provide getNextUniqueIdentifier, getLanguages, selectedCodriverLanguage, getTextCompositor, getOfflineTextCompositor, getVisualCompositor2, resolveActiveVoicepack, load*PacenoteMetadata, etc.
C.noteFields = { before, beforeMeters, note, after, afterMeters }: keys of the fields of a per-language text (self.notes[lang]).
self.notes is no longer saved: onSerialize does not write the texts; the structured text is rebuilt on load. A notebook in freeform mode therefore loses its free text on save ('W' warning logged).

Probable bug: playbackAllowed uses the variable `context` whereas its definition is commented out (local context = {currLap, maxLap}); setfenv(func, context) therefore receives nil (global) and the "Lua code" branch fails or behaves in an undefined way. Only nil/empty, true/t, false/f are reliable.
validate() fills self.validation_issues and returns nothing; use is_valid() afterwards (true if no issues).
The drawing modes (drawDebugPacenote*) depend on pacenoteToolsState (selected_pn_id, selected_wp_id, shift, showMeasurements) provided by the editor; they are meaningless outside the editor.
setNavgraph is a stub that logs 'setNavgraph() not implemented'.
The "after" distance is measured from cornerEnd by default, or from cornerStart if distanceMeasureWaypoint == 'cs' (default value 'ce', not serialized as long as it is 'ce').

C.desc: Pacenote instance. Fields: notebook, id, pk (stable random identifier), name, todo, playback_rules (text condition), isolate, triggerType, slowCornerReleaseType, slowCorner, ignoreDistanceCalls, includeLinkWord, distanceBeforeModifier, distanceMeasureWaypoint, audioMode, notes (by language), structured, pacenoteWaypoints (sortedList), metadata (metadata.system hides the structured mode), measurements {corner1, corner2, splitPoint, variants, selectedType, selected}, sortOrder, validation_issues, halfpoint, prevNote/nextNote, customAudioAnchors.

init.desc: Constructor: initializes all fields to defaults (dynamic trigger, auto audio mode, empty texts per notebook language, empty structured, empty waypoint list).

getNextUniqueIdentifier.desc: Delegates to the notebook to obtain a unique identifier (used by the waypoints).

getNextWaypointType.desc: Type of the next waypoint to create: cornerStart if missing, otherwise cornerEnd if missing, otherwise nil.

setAllRadii.desc: Sets the radius of all waypoints (or only those of one type).

wpType.desc: Type to filter, nil for all.

allToTerrain.desc: Snaps each waypoint to the terrain with zSnap.zSnapWithCurrentMethod.

noteOutputFreeform.desc: Final free text of a language, with before/after distance variables interpolated. Empty string if compilation failed or the note is unusable.

lang.desc: Language (default: that of the selected co-driver).

structuredPhraseEntriesOnline.desc: Phrase entries of the "online" text compositor for the projected structured content; can resolve the mission voicepack's audio variants.

distBefore.desc: Override of the before distance text.

distAfter.desc: Override of the after distance text.

returns.desc: Entries { text, category, ... }; nil if no compositor.

structuredPhraseEntriesOffline.desc: Same for offline mode (active voicepack and offline compositor).

returns.desc: Entries; nil without voicepack or compositor.

noteOutputStructuredOnline.desc: List of online structured mode texts; if the compositor is absent, falls back to the texts stored in self.notes[lang].note.structured.

noteOutputStructuredOffline.desc: List of offline structured mode texts ({} if unavailable).

measurementTypeForCorner.desc: Normalized measurement type of a corner (via geoPacenotes.normalizeMeasurementType).

measurementVariantForType.desc: Measurement variant for a type, falling back to the default variant then measurements.corner1.

selectedMeasurementVariant.desc: Measurement variant matching the current corner.

structuredForProjection.desc: Copy of the structured { schemaVersion, items } enriched, on the corner, with the live measurements: direction (-1 left, 1 right), intensity (diameter), arcDegrees, arcMeters, chordMeters. Does not modify the source structured.

currentStructuredOutput.desc: Current structured texts (online), or the stored structured field as a fallback.

currentStructuredContentOutput.desc: Like currentStructuredOutput but without the before/after distances.

getNoteFieldBefore.desc: "Before" distance text of a language ('' if absent).

getNoteFieldFreeform.desc: Raw free text of a language ('' if absent).

getNoteFieldStructured.desc: Stored structured text of a language ({} if absent).

getNoteFieldAfter.desc: "After" distance text of a language ('' if absent).

setNoteFieldBefore.desc: Sets the "before" text and distance for the selected co-driver's language.

setNoteFieldFreeform.desc: Sets the free text of a language.

setNoteFieldStructured.desc: Sets the stored structured text of a language.

setNoteFieldAfter.desc: Sets the "after" text and distance for the selected co-driver's language.

getCustomAudioFiles.desc: Custom mode: asks the notebook for the clip names assigned to this pacenote (automatic distribution plus manual anchors) and resolves them to full paths via the owner voicepack.

getCustomAudioFile.desc: First custom audio file, or '' if there is none.

getCustomDescription.desc: Description (transcript) of the first custom clip, '' if absent.

clearResolvedAudioObjs.desc: Clears the cache of resolved audioObjs (variant draw).

clearCachedFgData.desc: Clears the compilation cache and the resolved audioObjs; call after modifying the content.

clearCompilationFailures.desc: Resets the compilation failure flag to false.

didCompileFail.desc: true if the compilation was marked as failed.

resolveAudioObjs.desc: Resolves (once per mode, result cached) the audioObjs: for each object with candidates, picks a variant at random (math.random).

audioLenTotal.desc: Total audio duration (s) of the active mode's audioObjs.

checkFilesExist.desc: true if all file names are non-empty and exist (FS:fileExists).

audioMode.desc: Mode (only used for a commented-out log).

audioObjs.desc: audioObjs of the current audio mode from asCompiled (resolved, cached); nil if compilation failed or the mode is unknown.

returns.desc: List of audioObjs (pacenoteFname, audioLen, category, structuredTimingAfter…).

audioObjsFresh.desc: Recomputes the audioObjs of the current mode without going through the compile cache.

asCompiled.desc: Compiles the pacenote (cached): audioObjs and durations for the four modes, preview text, before/after distances and the visual event (visualPacenoteEvent) produced by the visual compositor. Returns nil if _compileFailed.

returns.desc: { id, name, noteText, audioObjs*, audioLen*, visualPacenoteEvent, distanceBefore, distanceAfter }.

validate.desc: Fills validation_issues: missing cs/ce waypoint, empty name, empty note, missing custom file, missing freeform note or unknown transcription.

is_valid.desc: true if validation_issues is empty (after validate).

getAudioModeSetting.desc: The pacenote's own audio mode (may be auto).

getAudioMode.desc: Effective audio mode: the notebook's mode if the setting is auto.

getAudioModeString.desc: Readable name of the effective mode.

isAudioModeStructuredOnline.desc: true if the effective mode is structuredOnline.

isAudioModeStructuredOffline.desc: true if the effective mode is structuredOffline.

isAudioModeFreeform.desc: true if the effective mode is freeform.

isAudioModeCustom.desc: true if the effective mode is custom.

setAudioMode.desc: Sets the pacenote's own audio mode.

useStructured.desc: true if structured content is used: structured online or offline mode, and not a system pacenote (metadata.system).

selectedCodriverLanguage.desc: Language of the selected co-driver (via the notebook).

pacenoteTextForSelect.desc: Label for a selection list: second word of the name + ' - ' + preview.

triggerTypeAsSmallIndicator.desc: Abbreviation of the trigger type: I, csS, cs+50%, ce-5m, ceS; nil for the others.

getCornerStartWaypoint.desc: First waypoint of type cornerStart (sorted list), or nil.

getCornerEndWaypoint.desc: First waypoint of type cornerEnd, or nil.

onSerialize.desc: Data to save: oldId, name, pk, playback_rules, isolate, triggerType, slowCornerReleaseType, audioMode, todo, metadata, waypoints, structured, slowCorner, ignoreDistanceCalls, includeLinkWord, distanceBeforeModifier, distanceMeasureWaypoint (if different from 'ce'), customAudioAnchors (if present). The note texts are not written.

onDeserialized.desc: Reloads from the saved data: converts the old codriverWait into triggerType, ignores the legacy fwdAudioTrigger waypoints, copies data.notes if present and reloads structured.

upgradeFromV2ToV3.desc: Format migration: transforms each langData.note into { freeform = old, structured = {} }.

markTodo.desc: Marks the pacenote as to do.

setAdjacentNotes.desc: Stores the previous and next pacenotes (for drawing).

drawDebugPacenoteHelper.desc: Common drawing: cs, orbit camera, ce and measurement geometry according to drawConfig (cs, ce, campoint, measurement, texts, colors, radii).

drawDebugMeasurement.desc: Draws the measured arcs (fitted circle, points p1 p2 p3, fit quality) of the selected variant; ignores arcs with a diameter >= 750 m; marks the break points of multiple segments.

drawDebugPacenotePartitionAllSnaproad.desc: Drawing used when creating a pacenote (cs and ce, reduced radius).

drawDebugPacenoteNoSelection.desc: Drawing used when no pacenote is selected (cs only).

drawDebugPacenoteNoSelectionRainbow.desc: Colored variant of the no-selection drawing (cs color forced, optional label).

drawDebugPacenoteBackground.desc: Background drawing (cs and ce, low opacity).

showTextOverride.desc: Forces the text to be displayed.

drawDebugPacenoteNext.desc: Drawing of the pacenote following the selection.

drawDebugPacenotePrev.desc: Drawing of the pacenote preceding the selection.

drawDebugPacenoteSelected.desc: Drawing of the selected pacenote (cs, ce, camera point if the pacenoteOrbit camera is active, measurements).

waypointForBeforeLink.desc: Reference waypoint for the "before" distance: cornerStart.

getDistanceMeasureWaypoint.desc: 'cs' or 'ce' (default): waypoint from which the "after" distance is measured.

setDistanceMeasureWaypoint.desc: Sets the measurement waypoint (any value other than 'cs' falls back to 'ce' and is not stored).

waypointForAfterLink.desc: Starting waypoint for the "after" distance according to distanceMeasureWaypoint.

distanceCornerEndToCornerStart.desc: Distance along the road between this pacenote's "after" link waypoint and the next one's cornerStart, via snaproad:distanceBetweenPositions. Returns 0.0 if a waypoint is missing and nil if no snaproad is available.

noteOutputCustom.desc: Custom mode: descriptions of the assigned clips, joined by ' | '; nil if there are none.

noteOutputPreview.desc: Text preview according to the mode (structured, freeform, custom); '<empty>' if nothing; prefixed with '[S] ' for a slow corner.

noteTextForDrawDebug.desc: Text displayed above the waypoint in the 3D view (= noteOutputPreview).

audioFnameFreeform.desc: Path of the freeform text's audio file in the mission's freeform folder.

audioItemsStructuredOnline.desc: Audio items of the structured online mode: { candidates, category } or { fname, category } per phrase.

audioFnamesStructuredOnline.desc: File names (first candidate if several) of the structured online mode.

audioItemsStructuredOffline.desc: Audio items of the structured offline mode, according to the active voicepack; empty list without voicepack or compositor.

audioFnamesStructuredOffline.desc: File names of the structured offline mode.

playbackAllowed.desc: Evaluates playback_rules: empty/nil or 'true'/'t' allows, 'false'/'f' denies, otherwise the condition is compiled with loadstring and executed (see notes: bug on `context`). Returns the result and an optional error message.

vehiclePlacementPosAndRot.desc: Position and rotation to place a vehicle before the pacenote: distAway meters from cs along its normal, on the side opposite ce, facing cs.

returns.desc: Rotation; nil, nil if cs or ce is missing.

nameComponents.desc: Splits the name into a base and a trailing number (pattern "(.-)%s*([%d%.]+)$").

matchesSearchPattern.desc: true if the freeform text of one of the languages matches the search pattern (rallyUtil.matchSearchPattern).

_moveWaypointTowardsStepper.desc: Moves a waypoint forward by 2 m along the road, reruns the notebook's autofillDistanceCalls and realigns the normal.

moveWaypointTowards.desc: Repeats the 2 m move of a waypoint along the road step times.

isLastPacenote.desc: true if this is the notebook's last sorted pacenote.

refreshFreeform.desc: Trims the freeform text and rewrites it, unless it is empty, blocked (autofill_blocker) or of unknown transcription.

toggleDistanceBeforeModifier.desc: Toggles distanceBeforeModifier (places the distance before the post-corner modifiers).

toggleIsolate.desc: Toggles isolate; when enabled, sets the before/after distances to the internal level autodist_internal_level1, when disabled clears them so that autofill takes over again (except blocked fields).

setSlowCornerReleaseType.desc: Sets the slow corner release type.

isSlowCornerReleaseCsStaticMinus40.desc: true if slowCorner and type csStaticMinus40.

isSlowCornerReleaseCsHalf.desc: true if slowCorner and type csHalf.

isSlowCornerReleaseCsStatic.desc: true if slowCorner and type csStatic.

isSlowCornerReleaseCeStatic.desc: true if slowCorner and type ceStatic.

isSlowCornerReleaseCeMinus5.desc: true if slowCorner and type ceMinus5.

refreshStructured.desc: Recomposes the structured online text and stores it in the structured field of the selected language.

getPosForOrbitCamera.desc: Position of the orbit camera (cached): centroid of halfpoint, cs and ce; otherwise midpoint of cs and ce; otherwise cs; otherwise (0,0,0).

generateFreeformFromStructured.desc: Generates a freeform text from the structured one (compositeTextEscaped), preserving the custom positions of the distance variables, and saves it.

canDeleteAudioFiles.desc: true in structuredOnline or freeform mode (generated files).

deleteAudioFiles.desc: Deletes (FS:removeFile) the pacenote's generated audio files according to the mode; no effect if not deletable.

deleteLanguage.desc: Deletes the texts of a language.

findItem.desc: First structured item of a given type.

findItems.desc: All structured items of a given type.

caution.desc: Item in slot 1 if it is of type caution.

hasCorner.desc: true if slot 4 contains a corner.

corner.desc: Item in slot 4 if it is of type corner.

hasModifier.desc: true if an item of the given type exists.

applyMeasurements.desc: Since measurements are projection data, only refreshes the structured text (refreshStructured) without changing the canonical items.
